question: The determined (or systematic) errors that can be committed in an analytical method:

options.opa: They cause the data to spread more or less symmetrically with respect to a mean value.
options.opb: They have a definite value and an assignable cause, giving rise to a bias in the results of a series of measures.
options.opc: They come reflected in the precision of a measurement.
options.opd: They are never attributable to instrumental measuring devices.
options.ope: They result in outliers, which differ greatly from the others in a set of duplicate measures data.
